title: Characterize exact residual tariffs for crossing coordinate cells
body:
## Summary

Classify PR3569's crossing-cell attainment question when target groups use the same binary coordinate basis. The self-contained proof gives exact VVV energy, a componentwise pinned exact-cover criterion for attaining the block floor, and universal MMM attainment in this geometry. For one cell per group with positive private counts s_A,s_B,s_C and m common coordinates:

```text
S = s_A+s_B+s_C, s = min(s_A,s_B,s_C)
VVV minimum = S+3m+min(m,2s)
MMM minimum = 2S+3m
```

This yields unbounded excess in a connected three-cell component and an exact optimal-reader transition at m=2s. The result covers every coefficient field of characteristic different from two and arbitrary ambient readers. Different shared-block bases, nonreducing spans and arbitrary queries remain outside scope. No physical supplier, kappa improvement or selected-frontier change is claimed.

Only `research/p112-crossing-attainment` is added. Proof, fixtures/results, two exact checkers, optimized CLI controls and replay metadata are self-contained. PR3569's exact proof is retained under COMPARISONS with origin commit/path/blob/SHA256 solely as handoff context. No inherited proof/runtime premise or foreign Git object is needed. Credit retains Nick Petalas/PR3569/3560/3549/3538, Philippe Van Velzen, Arham Tahir, Tekalign/PR3370 and the P112/E8/native/compiler lineage.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3569 supplies lower bounds and a strict 7/9 crossing example, leaving general correlated-cell attainment open.
  **After:** The written coordinate-aligned theorem gives an exact optimization formula, a necessary and sufficient floor-attainment criterion, MMM equality and the private/common closed form.
- Two implementations agree on all 26,487 VVV assignments across 149 fixtures, complete ordered total-charge hashes, histograms, minima and first witnesses. The second uses actual rectangular binary Gram matrices, enumerates MMM, and checks 39,784 integer/F3/F5/F7 ambient operator entries.
- Six malformed contracts and two forged records reject through both optimized real CLIs. Sixteen restored runs and two initial positives pass. Geometry mutants update authentication hashes; source/copy hashes and inode identities remain unchanged.
- At actual publication commit `013605b6a318f0ffe72a72f90c78a96aaffb4a14`, CPython 3.12 registered replay, metadata/pins and committed-byte/source-history checks pass. All three optimized scientific/control commands pass in a 13-file Git-free committed export with PATH=/nonexistent and unchanged source/export manifests. Ruff E/F/I/B/UP/ASYNC/SIM and formatting pass on the final committed code bytes before commit. Optional full-style diagnostics are retained and scoped in VALIDATION.md.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-crossing-attainment
python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p112-crossing-attainment --check-source-history
```

[Canonical investigation and original claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587#discussioncomment-19012822). Author-written proof completion does not claim independent human/formal acceptance. Hosted CI, selected full cold replay, physical acquisition/coefficients/frames/dirty restoration/hosting/precision/stock, compiler/all-size admission and full supplier/consumer/outer obligations are unclaimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** package

The new isolated package leaves shared code, frozen predecessors, canonical sources and the selected frontier unchanged.
